fusions.name: Gloaming Sip
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of darkness at a target at or below 30% health that deals 22 damage and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Carrying Call
fusions.desc: A call that carries through a 5-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 11 damage to everything in it and stunning it for 0.8 seconds. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Dusk Departure
fusions.desc: Lifts you 2 tiles from where you stood and increases your movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds, with 10% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Night Paddler
fusions.desc: At night your dodge chance rises by 12%. Your other abilities' cooldowns are 5% shorter.
